children.name: Halosaccion glandiforme
children.description: Halosaccion glandiforme, also known as sea sacs or sea grapes, is a species of red algae.

children.name: Palmaria palmata
children.description: Palmaria palmata, also called dulse, dillisk or dilsk (from Irish/Scottish Gaelic / ), red dulse, sea lettuce flakes, or creathnach, is a red alga (Rhodophyta) previously referred to as Rhodymenia palmata.
